verdict.rationale: The only multi-item behavior in the evidence is the search endpoint, which fetches the top 5 results and runs r.jina.ai on each URL in a single call. It can also scope one query across several sites. That is fixed, search-driven fan-out, not user-directed bulk processing of an arbitrary list of URLs. Missing for 10: a batch endpoint that accepts many user-supplied URLs or files per request, documented concurrency or rate limits for bulk jobs, async or job-based bulk processing, and independent corroboration of bulk workflows.
